name: Extremis-level Threat
summary: Once per battle in your Command phase: until your next Command phase, models with Oath of Moment also re-roll the Wound roll (not just the Hit roll) against your Oath of Moment target.

name: Legacy of the Angel
summary: On battle round 1, pick two of three Angelic Legacy abilities for Adeptus Astartes Characters, active for the battle: shoot/charge after falling back, re-roll a Hit/Wound roll of 1, or re-roll Advance/Charge. Army: Blood Angels only.

name: Shield of the Imperium
summary: Adeptus Astartes ranged weapons gain the Heavy ability; those that already had Heavy add 1 to the Wound roll when the firing unit Remained Stationary this turn.

name: Rapid Deployment
summary: An Adeptus Astartes unit disembarking from a Transport that moved this phase can make a bonus Normal move: D6", or D3+3" if that Transport has 14+ Wounds (a Heavy Transport).

name: Adaptive Defence
summary: Adeptus Astartes models in a terrain feature re-roll Hit and Wound rolls of 1. Units also gain Entrenched while in terrain, not set up that turn, and having moved 3" or less this turn.

name: Close-range Eradication
summary: Adeptus Astartes ranged weapons gain Assault, and get +1 Strength when their attack targets a unit within 12 inches.

name: Skystrike
summary: Land Speeder and Storm Speeder Hailstrike/Hammerstrike/Thunderstrike units count as Speeder; in your first Movement phase, friendly Speeder units can make an ingress move.

name: Target Sighted
summary: Adeptus Astartes vehicles (Tank Ace) automatically gain +6" Move instead of rolling to Advance, and re-roll Damage rolls when shooting if they did not Advance. Up to three may gain the Character keyword.

name: Armoured Wrath
summary: Once per phase, each Adeptus Astartes unit in your army may re-roll one Hit roll, one Wound roll or one Damage roll made for a model in that unit.

name: Legacy of the Angel
summary: Blood Angels Infantry Character units (except Commander Dante) get +1 to Advance and Charge rolls. Cannot combine with another Grace-tagged detachment. Army: Blood Angels only.

name: Red Thirst
summary: An Adeptus Astartes unit that Charged this turn gets +1 Attacks and +2 Strength on its melee weapons when it fights this phase. Army: Blood Angels only.

name: Psychic Disciplines
summary: Each battle round, pick a Discipline for friendly Astartes Psyker units until round end: Biomancy +2in M; Divination re-roll hit/wound 1s; Pyromancy +1 AP within 12in; Telekinesis -1 S vs ranged; Telepathy ignores BS/WS/hit modifiers.

name: Rapid-drop Deployment
summary: At deployment, a battle-size-scaled number of non-Titanic Adeptus Astartes units gain Deep Strike. A unit set up this turn re-rolls a Wound roll of 1; one that disembarked from a Drop Pod this turn also re-rolls a Hit roll of 1.

name: Maddened Ferocity
summary: Adeptus Astartes melee attacks re-roll a Wound roll of 1. A unit that Charged this turn gets +1 melee Attacks when it fights (+2 instead if Battle-shocked). Army: Blood Angels only.

name: Lightning Assault
summary: Adeptus Astartes units can declare a charge in a turn in which they Advanced or Fell Back.

name: Nowhere to Hide
summary: Friendly Phobos/Scout Squad units can mark a visible enemy unit within 12" as detected during your Shooting phase; a detected unit's detection range is increased by 3".

name: Upon Wings of Fire
summary: At the end of your opponent's turn, remove a battle-size-scaled number of non-engaged Adeptus Astartes Jump Pack units into Strategic Reserves; they Deep Strike back in during your next Movement phase. Army: Blood Angels only.

name: A Noble Death in Combat
summary: A Death Company melee attack re-rolls a Wound roll of 1 if its unit is below Starting Strength (any Wound roll if Below Half-strength). Death Company Marines (with/without Bolt Rifles) gain Battleline. Army: Blood Angels only.

name: Shadow Masters
summary: A ranged attack against an Adeptus Astartes unit from beyond 12 inches gives that unit Benefit of Cover.

name: Imperator Unleashed
summary: After a Fly Infantry unit makes an ingress or charge move this turn, its attacks can re-roll hit rolls of 1.
